---
title: "Web app"
subtitle: "Rate children's movement skills with the FG-COMPASS decision trees, right in your browser."
---

The FG-COMPASS web app walks you through the decision tree for each skill: answer one or two yes/no questions and get the child's level from 1 to 4. It works on phones, tablets and laptops, so you can use it in the gym, in class or in the clinic.

<a class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" href="assess/index.html"><i class="bi bi-phone" aria-hidden="true"></i> Open the web app</a>

## What it does

- **All 10 skills**, five locomotor and five object control, using the v2.2 decision trees.
- **Setup and instructions** for each skill: what to set up, what to say to the child and notes for the rater.
- **Session results**: a table of levels by child and skill, which you can download as a CSV file or print.
- **Class list and QR labels**: upload a class list, print a QR label for each child, then tap Scan in the app to fill in the child's name instead of typing it. Typing still works. [Make labels](assess/roster.html)
- **English** for now. A Portuguese version will follow, using the validated Portuguese wording of the decision trees.

## Privacy

Nothing is sent online. Ratings are kept only in the browser on the device you use, so a refresh or a closed tab doesn't lose them. They are removed when you tap Clear results, or automatically after 7 days. The app warns you before you leave with ratings you haven't downloaded. Download the CSV to keep a copy, and open that CSV again to pick up a session later or on another device. That makes the web app a good fit for teaching and practice: students can rate classmates or videos without creating accounts, and no children's data leaves their device.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
This is a prototype for teaching and practice. For research data collection, follow the testing protocols and record forms on the [Download](download.qmd) page.
:::

The [earlier prototype](https://fgcompass.shinyapps.io/throw/) (overhand throw only) is still online.
